title: Integrated sonication-assisted deep eutectic solvent for extraction of antibacterial compounds from cacao shells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19870-19884
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01724J, Paper
Open Access

Yuni Kusumastuti, Jordan Maulana Ma'arif, Muh. Irsal, Dewanti Cahya Widi, Nur Rofiqoh Eviana Putri, Mukmin Sapto Pamungkas, Lusiana Olivia, Jonas Kristanto
An integrated sonication-assisted extraction technique using green deep eutectic solvents is used to valorize cacao shell waste, allowing for the optimal recovery of bioactive compounds with demonstrated antibacterial activity.
